title: arctotis aspera f. scabra
intro: Arctotis aspera f. scabra, commonly known as the rough-leaved African daisy, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Arctotis aspera f. scabra include wound healing, reducing inflammation, and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
